blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Department of Education (DepEd) kicked off National School Safety Week at Cainta Elementary School by launching a nationwide campaign to strengthen the prevention of school violence, bullying, and online exploitation. National School Safety Week runs from Oct. 12 to 16 across all public schools and Community Learning Centers nationwide, featuring integrated safety lessons, emergency hotline awareness, and peer support frameworks. Education Secretary Sonny Angara emphasized that campus safety and learner protection are foundational requirements for quality education and overall learner well-being. “We will take a stand against bullying, violence, discrimination, and any form of abuse.
